areas.builder: Complete shared security headers and CSP

package.reason: Complete apart from Dustin's steps (CAA, DNSSEC, HSTS preload, TLS 1.2 minimum: /mnt/project-files/area2-round3/dustin-steps.md). Checked 31 Oct 23:05 to 23:40 UTC against v0.66.0. Every round-2 package gap is closed: S2, C3, C7, C9, I3 are graded for every registry site (a declared deviation is a warning, a missed one an error); the one deviation left is C3 on Cloudflare's injected beacon, which carries no nonce; the sink keeps integrity-violation and coep reports and COEP has report-to; applyHeaderSet has the 101 guard (headers.mjs:215); logoutResponse is gone; Portal and Desk are on the board; the Access gate reads 4xx as well as redirects; the signed-in crawl is a shared module. Open and accepted: Trusted Types, Integrity-Policy and COEP are Report-Only on the 14 page origins (only the 5 MCP workers enforce), so they report but do not block yet; nothing in the code sets a date or a clean-report rule for moving them to enforce.

dustinedwards-info.reason: Fails the newest check (v0.66.0, which the board runs) on C16: frame-src does not yet let in the post players the entry declares (embeds) and on I3: COEP is still enforced where an embedding site must keep it Report-Only. It passes v0.65.0 with 0 errors. Pin is v0.65.0 in package.json and mcp/package.json; a bump to v0.66.0 with the site's embeds change and a deploy fixes it. Re-check then.

Until the check judges those by their names, or the explorer hashes them, the board stays red on that cell. A1/A3 have no data without the CrUX key (Dustin's; the run shows PageSpeed 429). Not caught in round 2 because a cloud session's Node cannot decode zstd, so the home page body was empty and no files were sampled.
